limits: New development data drawn from source TRAIN, not official TEST or evidence of pretraining novelty. Exact ordered value/operator ASTs exclude training and earlier arithmetic panels; patterns can recur.
Scalar primary endpoint, frozen 3pp gate and controls are unchanged. All failures are retained; the zero-execution-error guard is conservatively checked across all fixed attempts.
20,000 paired document bootstrap draws with seed 2026101917. Unadjusted intervals are conditional on these checkpoints, not training-seed uncertainty. Seeds are never pooled.
No automatic extension, retry, checkpoint selection or new inference model. The supplied oracle contains the root answer; the own-note writer sees only the prefix.
Target CoT receives trace supervision on both passes; prior CPT received one plain and one augmented occurrence. Active-target totals and inference budgets differ and are reported as costs.
This supervised arithmetic reference does not establish thought-augmented pretraining benefit, emergence, broad reasoning or superiority to an optimized or few-shot base CoT prompt.
Native full16 scoring uses the same model on four fixed CPU references per mode; this is not all-panel CPU parity for every model. No controlled end-to-end service latency or RL-step claim.
